question: ________ is represented by the root apex's constantly dividing cells.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Meristematic growth'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meristematic growth phase:**

 
 
• The **constant dividing phase of cells at the shoot and root apex** both indicate the meristematic phase of growth.
 
• The cells present in the shoot and root apex are meristematic cells.
 
• Meristematic cells are the only cells of plants that have a tendency to divide.
 
• The cells present in the meristematic phase contain dense protoplasm, a large nucleus, a primary cell wall, and proplastids.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Increase hormonal level:**

 
 
• Plant hormones **control all the growth and development activities** like cell division, enlargement, flowering, seed formation, dormancy and abscission.
 
• Based on their action, plant hormones are categorised into two categories:** **
 
 
• **Plant Growth Promoters** - Auxins, Gibberellins, Adenine (Cytokinins) 
 
• **Plant Growth Inhibitors** - carotenoids (Abscisic acid) 
 
 
 
 
 
• **Germination:**
 
 
• Germination is the **process by which an organism grows from a seed or spore**.
 
• The term is applied to the **sprouting of a seedling from a seed of an angiosperm or gymnosperm**, the growth of a sporeling from a spore, such as the spores of fungi, ferns, bacteria, and the growth of the pollen tube from the pollen grain of a seed plant.
 
 
 
• **Maturation:**
 
 
• In this region, the **cells differentiate into various tissues, Specific** functionary organs ,Root hair absorbs nutrients and water from the soil.
 
• It anchors the roots firmly in the soil and transports water and nutrients upwards.
 
• Also, it **produces lateral roots**.
